# Eyota

> A true crime and investigative journalism blog covering cold cases, unsolved mysteries, and historical investigations with a focus on Minnesota cases and broader American crime stories.

Eyota publishes in-depth coverage of true crime cases, cold case investigations, unsolved mysteries, and historical investigations. The site also covers entertainment news and celebrity stories alongside its primary true crime focus.

## Key Topics

- true crime
- cold case investigation
- murder investigation
- unsolved mysteries
- Minnesota cases
- American history
- war crimes
- JonBenét Ramsey
- Watkins case
- celebrity news
- survivor testimony
- historical investigations
- viral stories
- entertainment news
- mystery stories

## Featured Investigations

- [Minnesota Cold Case Breakthrough: How a Trusted Family Friend Was Exposed in the 2016 Watkins Child Murder Investigation](https://www.theeyota.com/2026/03/minnesota-cold-case-breakthrough-how-a-trusted-family-friend-was-exposed-in-the-2016-watkins-child-murder-investigation.html): Investigation of 2016 Watkins child murder case in Minnesota
